verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no built-in AI assistant in Anytype. AI grounded in your notes is only possible by connecting external assistants through the official MCP server, the localhost-only offline API, or the Agents Skill, which gives assistants like Claude Code or Cursor a 'safe way to read, search, and modify Objects'. Revocable API keys and local-only operation provide some control over what the AI can access. Missing for 10: a native in-app AI assistant, documented in-app Q&A/summarize/draft features, granular per-space or per-object controls over AI data visibility, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
